resources.string:
"The camera feed, right there on your phone screen. The viewer doesn't care either way — the stream keeps going without it.

When to turn it off:
• the phone's getting hot (the screen roasts about as hard as the encoder)
• saving battery on a long stream"

"Smooths out shaky hands in software — steadier picture while you're moving.

Good to know:
• crops the frame edges a bit
• doesn't fit every mode (resolution/fps)
• pointless on a tripod"

"Locks exposure and white balance — the picture stops "breathing" brightness and color while you pan.

When to turn it on:
• panning across a scene with mixed lighting
• filming a screen/monitor (stops the flicker)

Turn it off if the actual light in the scene keeps changing."
"Scene\'s dark — the camera thinks it\'s worth flipping on."
